messages:
Tara M. (People Ops): Quick ops thread for Yuki Sato's SF onsite Wed Apr 20. He arrives SFO 06:45 from HND. Requests: later start ~11:00 PT (jetlag), kosher meal, temporary SIM/eSIM (we cover up to $30), visitor badge, low-contrast monitor option, and Google Meet fallback if customs delays. Also need clear instructions for JPY receipts + charity donation question.
Diego R. (Recruiter): Yuki prefers 11:00-14:00 PT. Asked whether we can prepay the SIM so he doesn't need cash. I'll check plate for parking and whether he wants airport pickup.
Asha P. (Office Admin): I can reserve Conf D + Quiet Room. Can prepare a low-glare monitor and a kosher boxed lunch. For SIM I can order a prepaid eSIM code and add to the calendar notes. Need candidate full name for badge (as passport).
Leo N. (Hiring Manager): 11:004:00 works for the panel. We'll split 75m design + 45m culture. Panel will join 10 min early.
Tara M. (People Ops): Reimbursement policy for JPY: originals preferred; photos accepted. Include conversion note: "amount in JPY converted to USD using xe.com on date of expense". For small purchases (like SIM) we can prepay; otherwise ask candidate to submit receipts to travel@redwood.example within 30 days. Charity donations aren't reimbursable  advise candidate.
Diego R. (Recruiter): Yuki would like the eSIM preloaded if possible. He'll confirm license plate tonight. I'll ask about any dietary cert wording he needs for kosher.
calendar-bot: Calendar event created: "Onsite  Yuki Sato" Wed Apr 20 11:00-14:00 PT  https://calendar.google.com/event?eid=yz123 (rooms: Conf D + Quiet Room, Meet fallback: https://meet.google.com/meet-yuki).
Asha P. (Office Admin): Badge template ready under "Yuki Sato". Parking permit held pending plate. Kosher lunch ordered for 12:15. eSIM voucher reserved  will attach code to calendar event once Diego confirms. Low-glare monitor set up in Quiet Room.
Diego R. (Recruiter): Plate = "TBA" (candidate checking). I told Yuki about receipts and charity policy and that we can preload the eSIM. He'll confirm tonight.
Tara M. (People Ops): Day-of checklist: 1) Confirm plate & update permit, 2) Confirm arrival ETA and pickup if requested, 3) Attach eSIM code to calendar if prepay, 4) Send final itinerary + Meet fallback 24h prior, 5) Remind candidate to email receipts to travel@redwood.example.
Leo N. (Hiring Manager): I'll be there early and bring an HDMI dongle. Thanks team.
Diego R. (Recruiter): I'll post final itinerary here after plate confirmation. Marking this the canonical day-of thread. :spiral_calendar:
